descriptions.sol29a_texture_set_construct_800f2ad0: Constructs the 0xc80-byte service object: calls its service base constructor, installs the native derived table, initializes three held interfaces and three vector headers, constructs 200 held slots and one additional slot, default-constructs its string and 23 by 16 five-byte candidate records, constructs its tail configuration, publishes the instance pointer, and sets both selection fields to -1. Factory, destructor and indexed candidate accesses independently support the member layout.
